title: Newham Council: Establishing the UK Centre for Artificial Intelligence for the public sector
summary: Newham Council and the University of East London propose using existing data to forecast housing demand and homelessness trends. Better temporary-accommodation planning remains an intended benefit.
account: Newham Council and the University of East London propose an AI model that would use existing data to forecast housing demand and homelessness trends for temporary-accommodation planning. Development is planned, with deployment and housing improvements unverified. Council expenditure of more than £20 million is baseline spending. A separate procurement and allocation application is under consideration.
purpose: Forecast housing demand and homelessness trends to support temporary-accommodation planning.
system: Proposed AI housing-demand and homelessness forecasting model
deployer: Newham Council and University of East London

ratings.reason: The council is intended to plan temporary accommodation more effectively using forecasts of housing demand and homelessness. The extent of any planning improvement or saving is unassessed.
Residents who need temporary accommodation are intended to benefit from better service planning. No resulting housing or homelessness improvement is established.

ai_role.statement: The proposed AI model would use existing data to forecast housing demand and homelessness trends. Its performance and effect on services remain unevaluated.
